title: Purchase Requisition
description: The approval gate before sourcing starts -- not a scheduling record (migration 0049 trimmed it down to exactly this: who's asking, the decision, and the decision trail). Matches public.purchase_requisitions. Title, Estimated Total, Currency, Requisition Date, and Required-By were all dropped; a Requisition no longer owns a line-item list of Procurement Items -- that link now lives on the item's own `requisitionId` (migration 0046/0047).
